name: A Stitch in Time
source:
When your childhood friend unexpectedly moves back into your life, the feelings you share take on a new form. As memories resurface, you navigate love shaped by time and distance.

[From [url=https://cydewyn.itch.io/a-stitch-in-time]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当你儿时的朋友意外地回到你的生活中时，你们所分享的感情就会以一种新的形式呈现。当记忆重新浮现时，你驾驭着由时间和距离塑造的爱情。

[来自[url=https://cydewyn.itch.io/a-stitch-in-time]itch.io[/url]]
